axis_xgmii_rx_64.summary: XGMII-to-AXI-Stream 64-bit receiver: lane-swap aligner and terminate detector feed a two-stage data pipeline, a 3-state FSM frames packets, and an LFSR CRC checks FCS.

blocks.name: Receive FSM
blocks.description: Three-state controller framing packets onto AXI stream and resetting CRC

anchors.name: state_reg
anchors.why: IDLE/PAYLOAD/LAST receive FSM controlling tvalid, tlast, tkeep and error outputs

anchors.name: xgmii_start_d1
anchors.why: Delayed start condition that moves FSM from IDLE to PAYLOAD

anchors.name: cfg_rx_enable
anchors.why: Configuration enable gating packet start acceptance

anchors.name: reset_crc
anchors.why: FSM-driven reinitialisation of CRC state between packets

blocks.name: Lane alignment and pipeline
blocks.description: Masks control bytes, swaps lanes for lane-4 starts, delays data two stages

anchors.name: xgmii_rxd
anchors.why: 64-bit XGMII receive data input masked and pipelined into payload

anchors.name: xgmii_rxc
anchors.why: XGMII control lane flags used for start/terminate detection and framing errors

anchors.name: lanes_swapped
anchors.why: Set when start appears in lane 4; selects swapped 32-bit lane alignment of data

anchors.name: swap_rxd
anchors.why: Holds upper 32 bits of previous word for lane-swapped realignment

anchors.name: xgmii_rxd_d0
anchors.why: First aligned data stage feeding CRC LFSR and second stage

anchors.name: xgmii_rxd_d1
anchors.why: Second data stage driving AXI tdata next value

anchors.name: xgmii_start_d0
anchors.why: Start character detected; captures timestamp and start_packet

anchors.name: xgmii_start_swap
anchors.why: Start found in lane 4; triggers swapped timestamp capture

blocks.name: Terminate and framing detect
blocks.description: Finds terminate lane and control-character framing errors

anchors.name: term_present_reg
anchors.why: Terminate character detected; ends packet in PAYLOAD state

anchors.name: term_lane_reg
anchors.why: Lane of terminate character; sets tkeep and which CRC check applies

anchors.name: term_lane_d0_reg
anchors.why: Delayed terminate lane used in LAST state tkeep and CRC check

anchors.name: framing_error_reg
anchors.why: Control characters inside payload; forces tlast, error and FSM return to IDLE

anchors.name: framing_error_d0_reg
anchors.why: Delayed framing error also aborting the packet

blocks.name: CRC checker
blocks.description: LFSR CRC32 over aligned data with per-lane residue comparison

anchors.name: crc_state
anchors.why: Running Ethernet CRC32 state, reset by reset_crc, updated from LFSR

anchors.name: crc_valid
anchors.why: Per-lane FCS match results compared against residues; decide bad_fcs

anchors.name: crc_valid_save
anchors.why: Registered CRC matches used for LAST-state FCS check

blocks.name: AXI stream output
blocks.description: Registered AXI-Stream output beat with keep, last and user

anchors.name: m_axis_tdata
anchors.why: AXI-Stream output payload driven from tdata register

anchors.name: m_axis_tkeep
anchors.why: Byte-enable output computed from terminate lane position

anchors.name: m_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: AXI-Stream valid asserted during PAYLOAD and LAST states

anchors.name: m_axis_tlast
anchors.why: Marks final beat of a packet on terminate or framing error

anchors.name: m_axis_tuser
anchors.why: Bad-frame flag bit plus optional PTP timestamp

blocks.name: Status and PTP
blocks.description: Error/start status pulses and start-of-frame timestamp capture

anchors.name: error_bad_frame
anchors.why: Status pulse for framing or FCS errors

anchors.name: error_bad_fcs
anchors.why: Status pulse for CRC/FCS mismatch

anchors.name: start_packet
anchors.why: Start-of-packet indication with lane position

anchors.name: ptp_ts_reg
anchors.why: Timestamp captured at packet start, placed into tuser

anchors.name: ts_inc_reg
anchors.why: Per-cycle timestamp increment used to adjust swapped-start timestamp

anchors.name: ptp_ts
anchors.why: PTP time input sampled at start of frame

axis_xgmii_tx_64.summary: AXI-Stream-to-XGMII 64-bit transmitter: a 7-state FSM inserts preamble, pads, appends CRC32 FCS from eight parallel LFSRs, and enforces IFG with deficit-idle lane swapping.

anchors.name: frame_reg

anchors.name: frame_error_reg

anchors.name: frame_start_reg

anchors.name: reset_crc
anchors.why: Reinitialises running CRC in IDLE

anchors.name: update_crc

axis_async_fifo.summary: Dual-clock AXI-Stream FIFO: block RAM written by binary/Gray write pointer, Gray pointers cross domains via two-flop synchronizers for full/empty, with frame drop/commit logic and an output pipeline.

blocks.name: Write controller
blocks.description: Accepts input beats, writes mem, advances/commits/rolls back write pointer, drops or marks frames.

anchors.name: wr_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Write-domain binary pointer addressing mem writes, incremented per accepted beat.

anchors.name: wr_ptr_commit_reg
anchors.why: Committed write pointer at frame end; rollback target for dropped frames.

anchors.name: full_wr
anchors.why: Packet overflow: current frame fills whole FIFO since last commit.

anchors.name: drop_frame_reg
anchors.why: Drop-in-progress flag discarding remaining beats of oversize/full/reset frames.

anchors.name: mark_frame_reg
anchors.why: Marks truncated frame bad when full; forces tlast and bad tuser.

anchors.name: send_frame_reg
anchors.why: Oversize frame being forwarded without drop; forces commits.

anchors.name: s_frame_reg
anchors.why: Tracks input frame in progress for reset/drop handling.

blocks.name: FIFO RAM
blocks.description: Dual-clock RAM storing packed stream words.

anchors.name: mem
anchors.why: Dual-port RAM holding packed tdata/tkeep/tlast/tuser words between clock domains.

blocks.name: Pointer CDC and flags
blocks.description: Gray pointer synchronizers and toggle handshake for commit pointer; full/empty compares.

anchors.name: wr_ptr_gray_reg
anchors.why: Gray-coded write pointer crossing into read clock domain; used for full check.

anchors.name: rd_ptr_gray_reg
anchors.why: Gray-coded read pointer crossing into write clock domain; used for empty check.

anchors.name: wr_ptr_gray_sync2_reg
anchors.why: Write Gray pointer synchronized into read domain for empty and depth.

anchors.name: rd_ptr_gray_sync2_reg
anchors.why: Read Gray pointer synchronized into write domain for full and depth.

anchors.name: wr_ptr_commit_sync_reg
anchors.why: Committed write pointer in read domain for frame-mode empty.

anchors.name: full
anchors.why: Full compare of write Gray pointer vs synchronized read pointer; blocks tready.

anchors.name: empty
anchors.why: Empty compare of read pointer vs synchronized write pointer; gates reads.

anchors.name: wr_ptr_update_reg
anchors.why: Toggle request transferring committed pointer to read domain.

anchors.name: wr_ptr_update_ack_sync2_reg
anchors.why: Synchronized ack toggle; equality with request permits next pointer update.

anchors.name: wr_ptr_update_valid_reg
anchors.why: Pending flag: commit pointer update deferred while sync in progress.

blocks.name: Read controller
blocks.description: Reads mem when not empty, advances read pointer, terminates frames interrupted by source reset.

anchors.name: rd_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Read-domain binary pointer addressing mem reads, incremented when not empty.

anchors.name: m_drop_frame_reg
anchors.why: Read-side terminate request after source reset; blocks reads.

anchors.name: m_terminate_frame_reg
anchors.why: Forces output tlast and bad tuser to close interrupted frame.

anchors.name: m_frame_reg
anchors.why: Tracks output frame in progress for reset termination.

blocks.name: Output pipeline

anchors.name: m_axis_pipe_reg
anchors.why: RAM output pipeline stages carrying read words toward m_axis.

anchors.name: m_axis_tvalid_pipe_reg
anchors.why: Per-stage valid bits shifting output pipeline data.

anchors.name: m_axis_tready_pipe
anchors.why: Downstream ready advancing pipeline stages and RAM reads.

blocks.name: Status and depth
blocks.description: Overflow/bad/good frame pulses with toggle sync, depth counters per domain.

anchors.name: overflow_reg
anchors.why: Overflow pulse on dropped frame; drives status and toggle sync.

anchors.name: bad_frame_reg
anchors.why: Bad frame dropped pulse, reported and synchronized to read side.

anchors.name: good_frame_reg
anchors.why: Good frame committed pulse, reported and synchronized to read side.

anchors.name: s_depth_reg
anchors.why: Write-side occupancy from write pointer minus converted read pointer.

anchors.name: m_depth_reg
anchors.why: Read-side occupancy from converted write pointer minus read pointer.
